notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped interaction ordering surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamp ordering across independent interaction producers, equal-timestamp cohort behavior, producer and tag identity, and lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped SendInteraction with FederateAmbassador timestamped receive callbacks across multiple producers
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped interaction and FederateAmbassador delivery declarations
